title: Tin Lung
prompt: drum n bass meets aphex twin with ambient intros
description: A tense, breathing pad opens in the dark before a snarling 606 break tears in at full neurofunk tilt. It peaks early on detuned dub-chord stabs, then dismantles itself into glitchy, vowel-warped fragments before the pad swallows it back up.
